_note: FR-203 · one folder per menu area under platform-src/v6/screens/<area>/. The folder is the ownership: a branch that works on an area edits files in that folder (plus its tests and help articles). Cross-area edits are reported by tools/check-areas.mjs (CI: lint job). 'shell' and 'shared' are common ground: edits there are always reported, and must be agreed with every running branch.
numbering: File name = NNN-kebab-name.js. NNN is the BUILD ORDER of the bundle (names sort as strings, so keep three digits). First digit = layer: 0xx core menu screens, 1xx menu add-ons, 2xx operations (W1/P1/P2), 3xx resources (W2/P3/P4), 4xx records and administration (W3), 5xx commercial and portals (W4), 6xx economics (W5/P5), 7xx rules and report extensions (R4), 9xx delivery. A new file takes the next free number in the layer; it must not move an existing file in the order. Names are unique across all area folders.
